cases.title: A fast standalone plan does not explain pool and lock waits
cases.prompt: Diagnose database-related latency from incident.md and assess the proposed index change. Identify the first bounded intervention and validation evidence while preserving the transaction contract. Keep this read-only.

rubric.criterion: Distinguishes application pool wait, server lock wait and standalone query execution; does not treat the 18 ms plan as proof of endpoint capacity.
Targets blocker/transaction lifetime with an invariant-preserving workflow or reconciliation design instead of moving a required check outside protection blindly.
Requests incident-window deltas, blocker evidence, fleet pool budget and representative contention/endpoint checks before recommending another index or larger pools.
Leaves the supplied fixture unchanged and distinguishes proposed checks from executed runtime evidence.

cases.title: Estimated row counts and repeated inner work reveal a plan risk
cases.prompt: Review plan.md and recommend the next diagnostic and smallest justified intervention. Explain the measurement limits and read/write tradeoffs. Do not execute database commands or edit files.

rubric.criterion: Connects the cardinality underestimate and 120000 repeated inner executions to the plan risk, interpreting per-loop values and avoiding double counting inclusive parent time.
Proposes checking statistics and tenant/parameter skew with representative plans rather than assuming one index or one plan fits every tenant.
Distinguishes EXPLAIN execution from client/network latency, preserves read-only scope and query semantics, and assesses index write/storage costs before claiming improvement.
Leaves the supplied fixture unchanged and distinguishes proposed checks from executed runtime evidence.

cases.title: A duplicate-effect correctness question needs its existing route
cases.prompt: Review contract.md and identify the duplicate-effect correctness issue and an appropriate bounded repair. Keep this read-only; query performance and capacity are outside the request.

rubric.criterion: Does not load database-performance or prescribe query tuning for the duplicate-effect correctness request; routes to idempotency or concurrency reasoning as appropriate.
Identifies the check-then-insert race and a durable uniqueness/atomic conflict boundary with retry identity handling.
Leaves the supplied fixture unchanged and distinguishes proposed checks from executed runtime evidence.
